what: Every word the making-of puts on screen, and who gets the credit for what. One entry per item: `text` is what is shown; `who` is dimitri or claude (a verbatim quote from the session, typos kept, trimmed only with …), or caption (a plain statement; `source` says what supports it); `when` is the local time of the message or event (MM-DD HH:MM, America/Los_Angeles), which also moves the clock on the timeline; `tag` credits the item (idea = HIS IDEA, call = HIS CALL: his answer to a question the model asked, rejected = REJECTED: a correction of his, approved = APPROVED, model = THE MODEL'S IDEA, cook = LEFT TO COOK) and `label` names what is credited. The tally on screen counts the tagged entries that have appeared. Change wording or tags here and render again; when each entry is on screen is in script.js; `node stories/makingof/check.mjs` holds the quotes to the transcript and the numbers to the stats.
